p: Ye take too much upon you: Or let it suffice you: meaning, to have abused them this long.
every one of them: All are equally holy: therefore no one should be preferred above other: thus the wicked reason against God's ordinance.
chosen will he cause to come: To be the priest and to offer.
ye take too much upon you: He lays the same to their charge justly, with which they wrongfully charged him.
him: To serve in the congregation, as in the verse before.
out of a land that floweth: Thus they spoke contemptuously, preferring Egypt to Canaan.
put out the eyes of these: Will you make those who searched the land believe that they did not see that which they saw?
before the LORD: At the door of the tabernacle.
congregation against them unto the door: All that were of their faction.
in all their sins: With them that have committed so many sins.
mind: I have not invented them from my own brain.
a new thing: Or, show a strange sight.
the pit: Or, deep and dark places of the earth.
against their own souls: Who caused their own death.
sign unto the children of Israel: Of God's judgments against rebels.
Korah: Who presumed above his calling.
altar: For it was not lawful to take any other fire, but of the altar of burnt offering, Le 10:1.
plague was begun among the people: God had begun to punish the people.
plague was stayed: God drew back his hand and stopped punishing them.
